content:
support_alice: heads up, multiple support tickets just rolled in — customers reporting 401s for API calls starting ~2025-06-15T09:12:xxZ.
sre_oncall: seeing the same on dashboards, spike in 401s across hosted and dedicated tenants. alert from console-alerts at 09:12 UTC.
sre_oncall: linking datadog error stream -> `auth-service.token_validation` shows a surge of `invalid_scope`/`token_claims_mismatch`.
support_alice: customers include `acme-inc` and `parse.ly` (reported via email). customers say calls that previously worked started failing without key rotation on their side.
dev_omar: I can reproduce from our cli: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate` -> `{"error":"unauthorized","reason":"missing required scope: inference.write"}` but that token had worked earlier.
idp_team_bot: Deploy completed: `auth-service@2025-06-15T09:10:02Z -> image sha: sha256:abc123`. No automated rollback.
marco_pm: was there a scheduled auth change? I thought rotation window for keys was 09:00 but no risky schema changes.
eng_ops: there was a last-minute claim normalization patch to treat `scope` claim as array instead of space-delimited string (fixes msft-jwt). It landed in canary at 08:50 and rolled to prod at 09:09.
sre_oncall: that matches timing. if tokens are strings they might be parsed as a single string instead of array and validation requires exact match.
dev_omar: dump from prod token introspect: `claims: {"sub":"svc-acme","scope":"inference.write inference.read"}` -> our validator now expects `["inference.read","inference.write"]`. current code rejects string scopes.
support_alice: customers don't want to reissue keys right now. we need a mitigation.
eng_ops: short-term mitigation: enable feature flag `legacy_scope_parsing=true` in config to accept both string and array. I can toggle config for the auth cluster.
sre_oncall: please do it and confirm metrics.
eng_ops: toggled `legacy_scope_parsing=true` on auth-prod-0/1/2; deploy-bot: `configrollout auth-config v2025-06-15-ff1 completed`
deploy-bot: "config-change: auth-config->legacy_scope_parsing=true by eng_ops at 2025-06-15T09:18:40Z"
sre_oncall: 401 rate dropped ~86% within 30s of flag flip. still a handful of failures — looks like some caches still serve old validators.
dev_omar: forcing cache invalidate on kv-cache for auth-service: `POST /internal/cache/invalidate?pattern=auth-validator-*` -> gives 202 accepted.
eng_ops: cache invalidation completed across all zones. 401s down to baseline.
support_alice: confirming with `acme-inc` — they say immediate recovery after ~09:19 UTC, thanks.
billing_ops: FYI we saw a handful of billing/usage discrepancies tied to failed creates (some customers re-tried and hit rate limits). need to audit metering for 09:10–09:25 window.
marco_pm: action items: 1) rollback the change from today into a branch, 2) PR to make parsing robust, 3) postmortem and customer comms. assign owners?
dev_omar: I'll open the rollback PR and revert the normalization for now.
eng_ops: we should also backfill a canary validation step to assert both string/array representations in CI.
sre_oncall: creating incident ticket and notifying cs escalation list.
sre_oncall: root cause summary draft: claim normalization change in auth-service treated `scope` consistently as array, which caused older tokens with space-delimited string `scope` claim to be rejected during validation. regression triggered by prod rollout at 09:09.
support_alice: suggested customer comms: sorry for interruption, we patched validation to accept older tokens and have a full fix/rollback in progress. offer priority key reissue if they want.
eng_ops: timeline for complete fix: rollback deployed within next 2 hours, followed by QA and controlled re-rollout with extra canary checks.
dev_omar: repro steps for engineering: 1) grab a token with scope as string, 2) call `POST /introspect` on staging with updated validator -> should see rejection; 3) flip `legacy_scope_parsing=false` to validate failure. Example:```bash
# old-style token
TOKEN=oldstyle-token
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://staging-auth.internal/v1/introspect -d '{"token":"'$TOKEN'"}'
# expect: {"active":false, "error":"invalid_scope"}
```
eng_ops: commands we used for rollback/mittigation:```bash
# enable legacy parser
kubectl exec -n infra configmap/auth-config -- patch -p '{"data":{"legacy_scope_parsing":"true"}}'
# invalidate auth validator cache
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/auth/cache/invalidate?pattern=auth-validator-*" -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>"
# rollback if needed
kubectl set image deploy/auth-service auth-service=registry.redwood/auth-service:2025-06-14-rc3 -n infra
```
sre_oncall: we rolled the config flag back to true then staged a rollback of the binary. rollback to `2025-06-14-rc3` completed at 09:45; deploy-bot reports `auth-service@2025-06-14-rc3` active in all clusters.
deploy-bot: "deploy event: auth-service->registry.redwood/auth-service:2025-06-14-rc3 by eng_ops at 2025-06-15T09:45:12Z"
sre_oncall: post rollback, monitoring shows 401s at baseline and no customer complaints in last 20m.
billing_ops: starting audit for 09:05–09:30 window and will share a short CSV of affected usage IDs.
marco_pm: please capture the PR id, timeline, affected customers, and mitigation steps in the postmortem. CC: legal & support for any SLA impacts.
dev_omar: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/auth-service/pull/482 (revert claim normalization)
eng_ops: follow-up work: add unit test that accepts both string and array, add regression test in canary pipeline, ensure feature flag defaults to true with gradual removal after clients migrate.
sre_oncall: sev: high, impact: auth failures for both hosted and dedicated customers for ~09:09–09:19 before mitigation, residual window until 09:45 for full rollback.
support_alice: I am sending targeted customer comms and offering 1:1 key reissue where needed.
marco_pm: flagging for postmortem, assigned to dev_omar + eng_ops. please add timeline and customer list.
sre_oncall: closing incident thread here once postmortem is posted. thanks all. :thumbsup:
